title: Stones Across the Nile | V1 Illustrated Short
script:
How did the builders move heavy stone blocks across Egypt?

At the quarry, workers dragged blocks up loading ramps.

They secured the cargo with thick ropes.

Then boats sailed along the Nile to the building site.
